meta.name: SCAiL Content Engine
meta.purpose: The self-updating loop. On a schedule, a delegated agent scans for South Carolina AI news, proposes new course topics from real community needs, rotates featured media, drafts newsletter and show notes, and commits the updates — so the site and course materials keep building themselves while Joshua focuses on connecting with people, places, and things.
meta.philosophy: Joshua does the human work — the meetings, the trust, the handshakes. The engine does the building work — the content, the drafts, the updates.

loops.name: SC AI News Scan
loops.description: Scans for AI news relevant to South Carolina — policy, workforce, education, local companies — and drafts Palmetto AI Brief items and Institute field notes.

loops.name: Course Needs Detector
loops.description: Reviews contact notes, event feedback, and community signals to propose new course topics and show episodes based on what people actually need.

loops.name: Featured Media Rotation
loops.description: Rotates the featured photo/gallery order across the site so it always feels fresh and current.

loops.name: Event Pipeline Sync
loops.description: Keeps upcoming events current — promotes planned classes, archives past ones, updates registration counts.

log.summary: Content Engine initialized. Brand house site launched with Academy, The Palmetto AI Show, SCAiL Institute, Events, and The Palmetto AI Brief. Seeded initial content across all channels.
